title: Finite-type relations for the quotient of a finite presentation
statement: Let X be a ringed space, U an open subset, and f : G → H a morphism of module sheaves [def-weil-sheaf-of-modules-category]. Assume G is of finite type. For any finite global presentation P of H restricted to U [def-weil-pbc-module-finite-type-presentation], the kernel of the composite of its finite-free generator epimorphism with the restriction of the cokernel map of f is of finite type. No global finite presentation of H is assumed.

source.place: Modules, Lemma 0H96 (lemma-cokernel-finite-finite-presentation), lines 1431-1450; used in Properties, Lemma 01PJ, lines 3112-3116

proof.text: The relations of P generate M = kernel(P.generators.π) by an epimorphism from a finite free module, so M is of finite type. Restrict G to U; finite type is preserved by restriction. The image I of f|U is an epi image of that finite-type source. Let N be the kernel of the composite generator map with c|U, where c is the cokernel map of f. The generator map restricts to N → I. It is epi because sections of I locally lift along the generator epi, and every such lift lies in N. Its kernel is M: all kernels are sectionwise, so the vanishing equation is exactly that of M. Hence 0 → M → N → I → 0 is short exact. Apply finite-type closure under extensions to obtain N of finite type. This is steps 3–5 of the original Stacks argument.
